installIntro: Homebrew is the simplest option on macOS. The formula includes ffmpeg and mpv.

installSteps.title: Install with Homebrew
installSteps.body: Installs the mls binary and media tools. Add trash separately if you want safe deletion in triage mode.

installSteps.title: Open a folder
installSteps.body: The interactive TUI appears when output is a terminal. Use arrow keys or hjkl to navigate; press ? for help.

installSteps.title: Or install with Cargo
installSteps.body: The crate is named media-ls; the command is mls. Install ffmpeg and mpv separately for media probing and playback.

faqs.a: No. Browsing and metadata extraction run locally. You choose what to do with the structured output.

faqs.q: What is the difference between JSON and NDJSON?
faqs.a: --json returns one document containing entries, summary, and errors. --ndjson streams records as files are probed. Piping output selects NDJSON automatically; use --json explicitly when your consumer expects one document.
PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODF, legacy Office formats, CSV, TSV, TXT, and Markdown are supported. Available fields vary by format.

faqs.q: Can I play or clean up files?
faqs.a: Use mls play for playback through mpv. mls triage provides an interactive keep/delete workflow. Install trash to move deleted files to Trash; triage can change your files.
Use explicit --json or --ndjson output, inspect errors and exit codes, and keep playback or triage separate from read-only inspection. The agent guide includes examples and the JSON reference.

agentIntro: Call mls locally with an explicit output mode. The website provides instructions; it cannot inspect a visitor’s files.

interactiveDemo: The preview recreates the MLS terminal in a Mac terminal window. Navigate folders with arrows or h/j/k/l and Enter; use / to filter, s/S to sort, 1–5 for kind filters, Space to mark, i for metadata, and p/P and [/] for mock playback. q exits to a sample prompt; running mls opens the browser again. Music includes WAV and FLAC metadata from real MLS output. File selection updates the JSON example. No local files are inspected or modified.
